transcriptions.A:
[page: 1]
Sauerbraten

Ingredients
1/2 l vinegar
1/2 l water
4 sliced onions
pepper
cloves
salt
bay leaves
beef roast

Method
Boil 1/2 l vinegar, 1/2 l water and 4 sliced onions with pepper, cloves,
salt and bay leaves.
Pour the marinade over the beef roast for a shorter rest.
For a longer rest, cool the marinade before adding the beef roast.

[page: 2]
bacon
butter
some apples (optional)
carrots (optional)
juniper berries (optional)
beef drippings
flour
red wine
soaked currants
raisins
sugar to taste

Method
Render the bacon, add butter, then brown the dried beef roast on all sides.
When the roast is browned, pour in a little of the marinade.
Add apples, carrots and juniper berries to the pot if desired.
Cover the pot and braise the beef roast gently until tender.
Stir flour into the beef drippings and loosen the mixture with marinade and red wine.
Add soaked currants, raisins and sugar to taste, balancing sweetness and acidity.
Let the beef roast rest in the sauce before slicing and serving.

changes.reason: A seitan roast provides a sliceable, substantial centerpiece that can take on the marinade, brown, and braise in the recipe.
Vegetable oil supplies the cooking fat used when rendering the bacon before browning the roast.
Vegan butter supplies the additional fat for browning and is a real plant-based butter product.
Vegetable oil provides the fat needed to stir in flour and form the sauce base.
Vegan-labelled red wine can be used directly to loosen and flavor the sauce without uncertainty about animal-derived fining agents.

changes.before: Pour the marinade over the beef roast for a shorter rest.
changes.after: Pour the marinade over the seitan roast for a shorter rest.
changes.reason: The seitan roast can take on the marinade in the same resting step.

changes.before: For a longer rest, cool the marinade before adding the beef roast.
changes.after: For a longer rest, cool the marinade before adding the seitan roast.
changes.reason: Cooling the marinade before adding the seitan roast preserves the recipe's longer-rest method.

changes.before: Render the bacon, add butter, then brown the dried beef roast on all sides.
changes.after: Heat the vegetable oil, add vegan butter, then brown the dried seitan roast on all sides.
changes.reason: Heating vegetable oil replaces the fat-rendering role; vegan butter supplies the additional browning fat, and the seitan roast can be browned on all sides.

changes.before: When the roast is browned, pour in a little of the marinade.
changes.after: When the seitan roast is browned, pour in a little of the marinade.
changes.reason: This keeps the deglazing step tied to browning the replacement roast.

changes.before: Cover the pot and braise the beef roast gently until tender.
changes.after: Cover the pot and braise the seitan roast gently until heated through.
changes.reason: Seitan roast is already cooked and will not become tender like raw beef; gentle braising heats it through while it takes on the sauce.

changes.before: Stir flour into the beef drippings and loosen the mixture with marinade and red wine.
changes.after: Stir flour into the vegetable oil and loosen the mixture with marinade and vegan-labelled red wine.
changes.reason: Vegetable oil provides fat for the flour-thickened sauce, and vegan-labelled red wine retains the recipe's wine component.

changes.before: Let the beef roast rest in the sauce before slicing and serving.
changes.after: Let the seitan roast rest in the sauce before slicing and serving.
changes.reason: Resting the seitan roast in the sauce lets it take on the finished sauce before slicing.
